sentiment: Some problems wait twenty years for the right mind; some tools wait longer. Nothing forgotten is truly gone — it merely lacks its hour.

stories.title: OpenAI GPT–6 Astra breaks Enigma message that has resisted solution since 2005
stories.summary: A message that resisted every attempt since 2005 finally falls. Patience is not passivity — it is keeping the question open until the right instrument arrives.

stories.title: Microsoft killed FoxPro in 2007. Anyway, here's FoxPro revived
stories.summary: A language declared dead in 2007 returns anyway. Tools do not die when support stops; they wait quietly for the people who still need them.
